sourceTexts.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ הָיְתָה תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ וְחֹשֶׁךְ עַל פְּנֵי תְהוֹם וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם
sourceTexts.aramaic: וְאַרְעָא הֲוָת צָדְיָא וְרֵיקָנְיָא וַחֲשׁוֹכָא עַל אַפֵּי תְהוֹמָא וְרוּחָא מִן קֳדָם יְיָ מְנַשְּׁבָא עַל אַפֵּי מַיָּא
sourceTexts.greek: ἡ δὲ γῆ ἦν ἀόρατος καὶ ἀκατασκεύαστος καὶ σκότος ἐπάνω τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐπεφέρετο ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος
sourceTexts.latin: Terra autem erat inanis et vacua et tenebrae erant super faciem abyssi et spiritus Dei ferebatur super aquas
sourceTexts.geez: ወምድርሰ ኢትሬአይ ወኢተደልወት ወጽልመት ላዕለ ቀላይ ወመንፈሰ እግዚአብሔር ይጼልል ላዕለ ማይ
sourceTexts.syriac: ܘܐܪܥܐ ܗܘܬ ܬܘܗ ܘܒܘܗ ܘܚܫܘܟܐ ܥܠ ܐܦܝ ܬܗܘܡܐ ܘܪܘܚܗ ܕܐܠܗܐ ܡܪܚܦܐ ܗܘܬ ܥܠ ܐܦܝ ܡܝܐ
sourceTexts.coptic: p-kahi de ne u-at-nau pe nem u-at-sobte pe nem u-kaki hi-jen p-nūn nem u-pneuma nte phnuti ne f-phēu hi-jen ni-mōu pe
sourceTexts.armenian: Եւ երկիրն էր աներեւոյթ եւ անպատրաստ. եւ խաւար ի վերայ անդնդոց. եւ հոգի Աստուծոյ շրջէր ի վերայ ջուրց

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre a face das águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was without form and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra estava desolada e vazia, e trevas sobre a face do abismo, e um vento/espírito de diante do Senhor soprava sobre a face das águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was desolate and empty, and darkness over the face of the deep, and a wind/spirit from before the Lord was blowing over the face of the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra era invisível e inacabada, e trevas estavam sobre o abismo, e o espírito de Deus movia-se sobre a água.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was invisible and unfinished, and darkness was over the abyss, and the spirit of God moved over the water.

literalTranslations.pt: A terra, porém, era vazia e sem forma; e as trevas estavam sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus movia-se sobre as águas.
literalTranslations.en: The earth, however, was empty and unformed; and darkness was over the face of the abyss; and the Spirit of God moved over the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra estava sem forma e sem preparo, e trevas sobre a face do abismo, e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre as águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was without form and unprepared, and darkness over the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God hovered over the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra estava sem forma e vazia, e trevas sobre a face do abismo, e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre a face das águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was formless and empty, and darkness over the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra estava invisível e não ordenada, e trevas sobre o abismo, e o Espírito de Deus movia-se sobre as águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was unseen and not ordered, and darkness over the deep, and the Spirit of God moved over the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E a terra era invisível e sem preparo; e trevas sobre o abismo; e o Espírito de Deus movia-se sobre as águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the earth was invisible and unprepared; and darkness over the deep; and the Spirit of God moved over the waters.

ptLiteralVerse: E a terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre a face das águas.
enLiteralVerse: And the earth was without form and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Ve-haaretz hayetah tohu va-vohu ve-choshek al penei tehom ve-ruach Elohim merachefet al penei hamayim
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: E a terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus pairava sobre a face das águas.
